page.notes: Doubtful readings: "Sanates" (tit.28.147) and "debaant" are as printed; "Sacrificia nocturnā" has a macron as printed. "Scævolæ" is printed with a ligature, rendered æ. The Greek σοφός is copied as printed. The u/v spelling is normalised ("unde"). Long s is rendered as plain s, so "potest" and "possessio" are given in modern form. Faint mark at the foot right is not text and is omitted.
